subject: Weekly leadership snapshot: OKRs, QBR prep, asks
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-11-12T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Weekly leadership snapshot: OKRs, QBR prep, asks

Team —

Quick snapshot for this week (high-level wins, current risks, and asks ahead of the Zephyr QBR on 11/20):

Wins
- Growth OKR (Free-trial to paid): Conversion experiment #3 rolled out last Tuesday; early signal shows +6% lift in MQL->PQL for targeted segments. Heatmap and segment details attached (2028Q4_OKR_progress_board.pdf).
- Infra: Dedicated pool autoscaler tuned — 18% lower p99 latency for hosted API during concurrency spikes (thanks to Marissa’s patch).
- Support: Closed the top three reliability incidents; mean time to recovery improved from 42m -> 18m.

Risks
- Zephyr procurement is pushing for a shorter SLA latency SLA and additional audit logs (see external thread below). If we can’t commit to their tighter latency window, they may request a price concession.
- Model regression flakiness on long-context summarization for sequences > 8k tokens — affects enterprise demos. Research has a mitigation but it will require one week of partner-kernel tuning.

Asks (action-oriented)
1) Approval: Requesting executive sign-off to grant Zephyr a trial SLA exception for 90 days while we deploy kernel tuning. This is documented in SLA_exception_request.docx (attached). If approved, we’ll provide strict fallback routing and a rollback plan. Decision needed by EOD 11/13.
2) Resources: Allocate 0.5 FTE from infra for the kernel tuning effort (target window 11/13-11/20). Jonas — can your team spare the slot?
3) QBR prep: I’ve added a lightweight appendix for the Zephyr QBR (QBR_appendix_v2.pdf). Please review and send edits by 11/15 so we can finalize the deck.

Short ask below — ping the one-liners in replies: Approve SLA exception? (Y/N), Infra slot available? (Y/N), Any changes to appendix (file link included)?

Thanks —
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Director, Growth Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-11-12T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly leadership snapshot: OKRs, QBR prep, asks

Dylan —

Thanks for the concise update. Quick answers:
- Approve SLA exception for 90 days contingent on the rollback plan and a clear success metric (p99 improvement target + no data loss).
- Please attach the rollback playbook to the appendix when you send the final deck.

Jonas — please confirm infra capacity.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product & GTM | Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-11-12T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly leadership snapshot: OKRs, QBR prep, asks

On 11/12/2028 Dylan Brooks wrote:
> Jonas — can your team spare the slot?

Short answer: we can re-prioritize one engineer (0.5 FTE equivalent) to support the kernel tuning for the week of 11/13. Two caveats:
1) We need clear acceptance criteria for what 'success' looks like for the tuning — target p99, and latency tail thresholds.
2) If the Zephyr work expands beyond experimental scope (e.g., model re-compilation or cross-region perf tests), we’ll need to revisit allocation.

I’ll sync with infra leads and outline the acceptance criteria by EOD 11/12.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Infra & Reliability | Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, maggie.chen@zephyrhealth.com
Date: 2028-11-12T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly leadership snapshot: OKRs, QBR prep, asks

Thanks — Laura, Jonas, appreciated. A few quick clarifications and the requested artifacts attached.

- SLA exception: I’ll embed the rollback playbook and add measurable success criteria (target: p99 end-to-end inference latency improvement from current baseline to -25% after tuning; no increase in error-rate > 0.5%).
- Infra slot: Jonas confirmed 0.5 FTE. Jonas — once you post the acceptance criteria I’ll coordinate scheduling and priorities with Marissa.
- Zephyr procurement: Maggie (cc’d) — we can offer the 90 day exception, with the rollback playbook and a weekly status update. Procurement team — can you confirm if weekly operational reports will satisfy your procurement team for the exception?

Attachments (in this thread):
- 2028Q4_OKR_progress_board.pdf — current OKR health and segment-level lift charts.
- QBR_appendix_v2.pdf — appendix for the Zephyr QBR (includes proposed talking points).
- SLA_exception_request.docx — formal request and conditional terms.

Next steps: I’ll update the appendix with the rollback playbook and acceptance criteria after Jonas posts them. If no objections by EOD 11/13, we’ll finalize and notify Zephyr legal/procurement.

Dylan
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-12T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly leadership snapshot: OKRs, QBR prep, asks

Quick ack from me:
- SLA exception: Y (contingent on rollback + metrics described).
- Infra slot: Y (thanks Jonas).
- Appendix: I’ll review and leave comments by 11/15.

- One operational note: remind CS to prepare a short runbook for Zephyr-facing support (one pager) so we don’t get surprised by operational questions during QBR. Marissa — can your team own that?

Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Chief Customer Officer | Redwood Inference
